title: Bodies of Four Nongshum Sunulok Victims Claimed from RIMS Morgue; JAC Reports Progress on Demands
summary: Bodies of four Nongshum Sunulok victims were claimed from the RIMS morgue after a November 19 agreement. The JAC says the government has agreed to several demands, including a departmental inquiry into the Lamlong tear gas incident.
body:
Imphal, November 22, 2026: The mortal remains of four individuals who lost their lives in the Nongshum Sunulok incident were claimed from the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) morgue on Sunday, following an understanding reached between the Joint Action Committee (JAC) and the state government.

Addressing the media outside the RIMS morgue, JAC Co-convenor T. Somorjit said the decision to take custody of the bodies and proceed with the last rites was reached after a joint meeting between the JAC and government representatives on November 19.

Somorjit said the JAC had submitted an 11-point charter of demands to the state government. He added that the authorities had already initiated action on several of the demands, indicating progress in discussions between the committee and the government.

Among the developments, Somorjit confirmed that the state government had agreed to initiate a departmental inquiry against Manipur Police personnel allegedly involved in firing tear gas during a recent protest at Lamlong. The incident reportedly left several demonstrators injured.

The agreement to claim the bodies marks an important development following the discussions between the JAC and the government. However, the JAC's statement indicates that several demands remain part of the ongoing process, with further action expected from the authorities.

The departmental inquiry is expected to examine the conduct of the police personnel involved in the Lamlong incident and the circumstances surrounding the use of tear gas during the protest.

Further details regarding the remaining demands, the scope and timeline of the inquiry, and the arrangements for the last rites were not provided in the information available.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
